sections.description:
Is AI Recommending YOUR Business… Or Your Competitors?

2.4 billion searches happen monthly on AI assistants. ChatGPT alone processes over 100 million queries per week. Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity are growing exponentially.

When your customers ask “What’s the best [your service] in [your city]?” – are they finding you? Or are they finding your competitors?

67% of customers now use AI to research businesses before buying. If your content isn’t optimized for AI assistants, you’re invisible to a massive and growing share of your potential customers.

Remember “Mobile First”? Welcome to AI First.

For over a decade, SEO meant optimizing for Google’s blue links. That era is ending.

AI-powered search is replacing traditional results. Google’s AI Overviews, ChatGPT’s web browsing, Claude’s research capabilities – they’re all changing how people find information. And they require a completely different optimization approach.

VisibleFirst is the first WordPress plugin built from the ground up for this new reality. Not AI bolted onto a legacy SEO plugin. Not features added as an afterthought. A complete visibility platform designed for how search works today.

The Problem We Solve

For nearly two decades, we watched good businesses stay invisible. Not because they weren’t good at what they do – but because our industry made visibility feel impossible:

  • Confusing audit tools that identify problems but never solve them
  • Marketing tactics that change with every algorithm update
  • Fragmented tools handling disconnected pieces of the puzzle
  • Legacy SEO plugins with AI features bolted on as an afterthought

Good businesses deserve to be found. Not someday. Not after mastering 300 SEO tactics. Not after hiring an expensive agency. Now. Today. With the business you have and the budget you have.

That’s why we built VisibleFirst.

What Makes VisibleFirst Different

We pioneered Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

While other plugins focus exclusively on Google, VisibleFirst optimizes your content for AI assistants. We were among the first to implement llms.txt – the emerging standard that helps AI crawlers understand your website (think robots.txt, but for LLMs).

We generate complete content, not just metadata

Other plugins help you write better titles and descriptions. VisibleFirst creates entire researched blog posts, complete with AI-generated featured images. Our multi-AI pipeline uses Claude for writing, Perplexity for research, Gemini for editing, and DALL-E 3 for images.

We create images, not just text

Need a featured image? Social media graphic? Open Graph image? VisibleFirst generates them on demand using DALL-E 3, optimized for each platform’s specifications.

We don’t nickel and dime

Every feature is available on every plan – including Free. No “upgrade to unlock” walls. No artificial limitations. The only difference between plans is how many AI credits you get.

Three Visibility Channels, One Plugin

VisibleFirst optimizes your content across three critical channels:

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Traditional search visibility for Google, Bing, and other search engines.

  • AI-powered title generation that captures search intent
  • Meta description optimization for higher click-through rates
  • Focus keyword analysis with actionable recommendations
  • 100-point SEO scoring with detailed breakdowns
  • SERP preview showing exactly how you’ll appear in search results
  • Content recommendations based on top-ranking competitors

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
The new discipline of getting cited by AI assistants.

  • llms.txt generator – the robots.txt for AI crawlers
  • Schema.org structured data that AI assistants actually use
  • AI visibility scoring across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity
  • Content clarity analysis ensuring AI can parse your content
  • Citation optimization for AI-generated answers

Social Media Optimization (SMO)
Make your content shine when shared on social platforms.

  • Open Graph tag management for Facebook and LinkedIn
  • Twitter Card optimization for maximum engagement
  • Social preview tool showing exactly how shares will appear
  • AI-generated social images sized for each platform
  • SMO scoring with improvement recommendations

VisibleFirst was founded by Dwight Davis, a digital marketing veteran with six years at Intuit managing a $256 million budget and a team of 28. After watching both enterprises and small businesses struggle with the same visibility challenges, he built the platform he wished existed.

Based in Boise, Idaho, VisibleFirst is on a mission to make visibility accessible to every business – not just those with enterprise budgets or dedicated marketing teams.

We believe that if you’re good at what you do, people should be able to find you. That’s it. That’s the whole mission.

sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard:

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “VisibleFirst”
  3. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  4. Navigate to VisibleFirst in your admin menu
  5. Check your visibility scores and start optimizing

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/visiblefirst/
  3. Activate through the Plugins menu
  4. Navigate to VisibleFirst in your admin menu

No API keys required. No complicated setup. Works immediately.
sections.faq:
What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?

AEO is the practice of optimizing your content to be cited by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. When someone asks “What’s the best Italian restaurant in Denver?” you want YOUR restaurant in that answer.

Traditional SEO focuses on ranking in search results. AEO focuses on being the answer that AI provides directly to users.

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is an emerging standard (similar to robots.txt) that helps AI assistants understand your website. It provides context about your business, key pages, services, and expertise – giving AI crawlers the information they need to accurately represent your business in their responses.

VisibleFirst was among the first plugins to support llms.txt, giving early adopters a significant advantage.

Do I need to replace my current SEO plugin?

No! VisibleFirst can run alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and others. Our coexistence mode lets you choose which plugin handles which features.

That said, VisibleFirst includes complete SEO functionality, so you can use it as your only SEO plugin if you prefer.

Is my content safe?

Yes. AI features process your content to generate optimizations, but we never store your content or use it for AI training. All processing happens in real-time and is immediately discarded.

See our Privacy Policy for complete details.

How is this different from Yoast or Rank Math?

Traditional SEO plugins optimize for Google’s search results. VisibleFirst optimizes for that AND for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

Key differences:

  • AEO capabilities: llms.txt support, AI visibility scoring, citation optimization
  • Content generation: Full blog posts with research, not just metadata suggestions
  • Image generation: DALL-E 3 images created on demand
  • Multi-AI approach: Uses Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, and Perplexity together

What AI models does VisibleFirst use?

VisibleFirst uses a multi-AI approach, selecting the best model for each task:

  • Claude (Anthropic): Primary content generation and analysis
  • GPT-4 (OpenAI): Complex reasoning and content optimization
  • DALL-E 3 (OpenAI): Image generation
  • Gemini (Google): Content editing and refinement
  • Perplexity: Research and fact-checking

Are there any hidden fees?

No. The subscription price is the price. There are no setup fees, no per-site fees, no “pro” features locked behind additional paywalls.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. All subscriptions can be cancelled anytime from your customer portal. You’ll retain access until the end of your billing period.

Do unused credits roll over?

Monthly subscription credits refresh each month and don’t roll over. However, credit pack purchases never expire – they remain in your account until used.
